note: kind registry = proven now by check_registries.py (the id is a check name). kind runtime = a planned test in the named chapter. enforcement_points name a transition precondition the checker confirms exists.

invariants.statement: No execution without a frozen contract.
No execution without a frozen source or subject state in the AttemptContract.
Every artifact belongs to exactly one attempt, by causal provenance.
Evidence cannot satisfy another task merely because it is newer.
A frozen contract's digests never change; acceptance criteria cannot change after freeze.
An LLM may propose but cannot authorize PASS.
PASS requires the contract's mandatory deterministic assertions.
For DIRECT_REF_CAS the committed tree equals the verified tree; MEDIATED is proven later by the mediated adapter.
Only an AcceptanceReceipt releases a successor.
Crash, restart or replay reproduces the same next state.
A TaskContractRecord never changes inside its Sequence; two Sequences with the same RequirementDigest are independent.
One current Attempt per Sequence.
Authoritative receipts carry sequence, attempt, version and fence; a stale fence yields no authority.
The Git sequencer acts only on a matching state, version, current attempt and fence.
Refs move by compare-and-swap; never force, never merge.
A source-modifying Sequence is ACCEPTED only after every finalization requirement has its receipt.
Verification binds candidate, environment, assertions and verifiers.
Evidence is attempt-bound; reuse of evidence across attempts needs an explicit rule.
A partial PASS releases nothing.
DEPENDENCIES_RELEASED is durable; restart resumes release.
specification_inputs is an explicit, closed set hashed as exact bytes; normalization is a separate registered transform.
Provenance comes from WitnessRecords, never from mtime or agent claims.
Integrity failures in the ExecutionReceipt block acceptance (refined by INV-68).
Publication needs a valid permit use: per-sequence or standing, reserved before the effect.
Interim: one InstanceLease holder at a time.
Target: an OS lock and the service identity's ACL as well.
Authority records name a principal; in the target the IPC peer plus the human-presence factor authenticate it.
Anything written to a repository carries IDs and hashes only, never machine paths.
No contract freezes outside the active DelegationContract's scope.
Each identity tier is deterministic from its own inputs and from no higher tier's inputs.
Evidence completeness depends only on raw witnesses; INDEX_LAG never blocks unless an assertion declares an HDB-derived query.
A READ_ONLY AcceptanceReceipt is scoped to its observation window.
A HUMAN_REQUIRED contract cannot reach ACCEPTED without an attestation for each human-attested assertion.
Delegation re-check at reservation and publication.
A delegated freeze includes the delegation's mandatory assertion floor.
Agents and the Planner's LLM never run under the service identity.
A Sequence moves its declared canonical ref exactly once, by CAS; that move is the point of no return.
Specification inputs are re-hashed at dispatch and at collection; a change is INTEGRITY_FAILED.
A source-modifying HUMAN_REQUIRED contract needs your attestations before COMMITTING.
For a REMOTE repository the PONR is the remote canonical CAS; local branches are projections and workspace sync is never needed for acceptance.
One Sequence per TaskContractRecord, except a duplicate admission returns the existing record.
Every authority consumption before the PONR needs an active delegation; at the PONR its state is frozen into the receipt; after the PONR recovery finishes forward.
Permit uses are reservation rows; consume and release each change a row from RESERVED exactly once.
Every externally visible push has its own receipt; staging pushes never move a canonical ref.
Specification identity is the exact bytes; prompt identity is the declared transform's output; A1 proves the chain.
authority_location is declared once per repository; a contract that disagrees, or whose finalization doesn't fit it, cannot freeze.
Workspace sync never moves a checked-out branch out from under its worktree; otherwise it records SKIPPED.

Every transition or lifecycle rule that mints an EffectIntent, including retries and standalone effects, atomically commits the intent with the authorization checks required by that effect class immediately before the effect.
consumed_uses + reserved_uses <= permitted_uses at all times; only the Sequencer changes permit state.
Child prompts are checked after the fact against their declared role transform; the Dispatcher projects only what it renders.
Reuse needs the same RequirementDigest and a dominating proof.
PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED releases nothing.
Only registered verifier and transform artifacts, at their bound hashes, produce results; registration is yours.
Every authority-affecting lookup is resolved at freeze to an immutable registration record; an unavailable bound artifact HALTs and is never substituted.
A payload matching the ContractDigest of a record with a non-terminal Sequence creates no record and no Sequence, unless it carries force_new_sequence.
Every ref or push effect runs under an EffectIntent with a bounded window; an expired intent authorizes nothing new.
v1 publishes only DIRECT_REF_CAS repositories.
PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED always mints a ForwardRepairObligation; a waiver closes it but satisfies no edge.
Bound artifact closures stay in the content store while any non-terminal record binds them.
A late consume against a released reservation is an integrity alarm, never a silent overbook.
Every reservation has its own renewable lease, independent of any intent.
Duplicate admissions are recorded by the Registry as DuplicateAdmissionRecords.
Remote ref outcomes: target at the new value is HAPPENED; at the expected old value is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; anything else is ABSENT. Grace periods are operational only.
Lease expiry releases authority, keeps every receipt and HALTs; resumption re-validates and re-reserves.
A contract whose finalization its bound repository mode cannot satisfy in v1 never becomes READY.
Source reuse requires the accepted commit to be the canonical head (EXACT_HEAD); ANCESTOR_OK is not available in v1.
A frozen contract executes the exact registered artifact closure, never whatever a filesystem path currently holds.
effect_hard_timeout < effect_intent_ttl; reservation leases are renewable and bounded by max_wait; effective bounds are the stricter of policy and config.
An orphan, a DENY-then-ran event, or execution with no recorded decision makes the ExecutionReceipt INTEGRITY_FAILED; DENY counts are diagnostic.
A missing required join makes the ExecutionReceipt INCOMPLETE.
An UNKNOWN_OUTCOME intent resolves only by observation, by an identical CAS retried under a fresh intent with active authority, or by your decision.
No state lies on both sides of a PONR on any path, and no resume can skip verification.

Receipts and authoritative state live only in the Autobot ledger and its content-addressed store; HDB is a derived index that never gates completeness, acceptance or state unless a TaskContract declares an HDB-derived assertion; Git holds source proof and path-free references only.
A retry intent may supersede UNKNOWN_OUTCOME only for a retryable attempt-scoped effect and binds the superseded intent while proving the identical effect, target and expected-old value.
Standalone effects use their own effect-class authorization rules; they do not inherit attempt permit/reservation/fence requirements.
Every effect with requires_intent=true has an intent-creation rule, an outcome path, and a receipt-producing successful path.
